independentContracts.requirement: Signal Split View shows the same canonical Signal list in a second (Lower) Cycle viewport, with independent vertical scrolling and one shared horizontal time domain.
independentContracts.acceptance: Signal Split is a workspace-only view toggle: no per-signal Upper/Lower/Both assignment exists; both panes render the identical canonical Signal sequence; vertical scroll is independent per pane; horizontal scroll/zoom/ruler stay in lockstep; toggling is view-only (zero Canonical/History/Dirty delta).
independentContracts.implementationEvidence: CORRECTION (2026-09-22, superseding all prior per-signal-assignment evidence below this note): an earlier implementation (PR #344-346) added a canonical signal.display.splitPane (upper|lower|both) field with Inspector assignment controls and per-signal pane-filtered rendering/export. This was explicitly reversed by a #570 product decision: 'Signal Split remains the same Cycle Signal list in two viewports (workspace state, not persisted)'. The splitPane field, its SignalDisplay type, its signal.updateProperties option/planner/validation, and its Inspector control are all removed from current main (verified: zero occurrences of 'splitPane' in packages/schema/src/types.ts, packages/commands/src/types.ts or packages/commands/src/planner.ts). A dedicated regression test (tests/e2e/signal-split-no-assignment-control.spec.ts) asserts no such control exists. Current production behavior: a View Ribbon toggle mounts a second (Lower) viewport via createSignalSplitLowerPane, rendering the exact same canonical Signal sequence as Upper (verified by comparing rendered row IDs between panes); vertical scroll is independent per viewport; horizontal scroll/zoom/ruler transform are mirrored through the same syncRulerScroll mechanism Upper already used. A document that still carries the legacy per-signal splitPane field (from before the reversal, or from an external file) has it read and silently dropped on Open, and it is never written back on Save (tests/schema/legacy-split-pane.test.ts).
independentContracts.unit: tests/schema/legacy-split-pane.test.ts: legacy splitPane is read-and-dropped on Open, never re-serialized on Save.
independentContracts.e2e: tests/e2e/signal-split.spec.ts (2/2): toggling is view-only, Upper's scroll position survives a Lower toggle-off/on round trip, horizontal zoom/scroll stay mirrored via the shared ruler transform. tests/e2e/signal-split-render-routing.spec.ts (3/3): both panes render the identical canonical Signal-ID sequence, a legacy per-signal assignment present in the document has zero rendering effect and the Inspector control remains absent, Signal Split is available only in Cycle View (not Transaction/Combined). tests/e2e/signal-split-no-assignment-control.spec.ts (1/1): no per-signal assignment control is ever rendered.
independentContracts.visual: Real Chromium evidence confirms both panes show the identical Signal sequence, independent vertical scroll, and mirrored horizontal ruler transform; no per-pane visual differentiation by assignment exists since no assignment exists.
independentContracts.saveOpen: verified: legacy splitPane is dropped on Open and never re-written on Save (tests/schema/legacy-split-pane.test.ts); Signal Split's own enabled/ratio state is workspace-chrome UI state, not persisted, matching bottomVisible/inspectorVisible.
independentContracts.export: Not applicable to the current model: with no per-signal pane assignment, there is nothing pane-specific to export beyond the single canonical Signal list export already covers. The #200-tagged combined-export code path referenced by prior evidence read a field that no longer exists in the schema and is dead/unreachable; this row's export claim is retracted, not carried forward.
